notes.title: Cube Escape Collection is 66% OFF in our Rusty Lake Anniversary Steam Sale! 🎂
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009977/85101fe90af9f7530ffd1c19793018841c016d64.jpg[/img]
[/url]
[h3]Happy 10 years of Rusty Lake![/h3] 🥳 And what better way to celebrate a decade of Rusty Lake than with:

[list]
[*] [b]A new free-to-play game: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show [/b]- hat tricks, sleight of hand, and a few unexpected reveals you don’t want to miss; 
[*] An early look at our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/]premium Rusty Lake game[/url]
[*] And special Rusty Lake anniversary merch in collaboration with Lost in Cult - available to pre-order right now;
[*] A week-long platform-wide discounts of up to[b] 66% OFF on all our premium games[/b], including hosting our very own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RustyLakePublisherSale]Rusty Lake Anniversary Steam Sale Page[/url][/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623373/7c9d1829faaad1d595d896039f60c2ee09bf7402.png[/img][/url]

Of course, the sale includes [b]Cube Escape Collection[/b], which you can now download and play for [b]66% off[/b]! Enjoy our first 9 Cube Escape chapters bundled and preserved for your puzzle-solving pleasure!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/

And don't forget to check out our [b]new magical puzzle game: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show[/b]. A free-to-play short but magical game filled with enough secrets and unexpected twists to put you in a celebratory mood!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472550/The_Mr_Rabbit_Magic_Show/

Keep an eye out for secrets while playing The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show, and you might just find an early look at our next Rusty Lake adventure! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/]Wishlist now[/url] to stay up to date!

[url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623373/79fc9db394a84f82d17eecccf67771e750806427.png[/img]
[/url]
As a special thank-you for your continued support over the past 10 years, we’re excited to further delight you with some special Rusty Lake anniversary merch in collaboration with Lost in Cult available to pre-order as of April 30th:

[list]
[*] 🎵 Rusty Lake: [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake]Sounds of the Lake 10th Anniversary Vinyl Collection[/url] - 20 of Rusty Lake’s Greatest Hits performed by Victor Butzelaar. 
[*] 🃏 A mysterious [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake]deck of cards[/url] (perfect for your own magic tricks) - designed by Maarten Pelders, inspired by the series’ surreal symbols and characters.
[*] 📖 A re-launch of our fan-favourite [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake]Paradox Comic Book[/url] by Lau Kwong Shing 
[/list]
Whether you’ve been a part of our Rusty Lake universe since the first launch of a Cube Escape title back in 2015, or you’ve joined our journey during our later years, we’d like to share a heartfelt Thank you! from the whole Rusty Lake team! 

Thanks to you and your incredible support, we’ve had an amazing 10 years, and we’re as excited as ever to continue exploring the mysteries of Rusty Lake with more video games, short films, tablet-top experiences and much more! We hope you’ll stick around for what’s to come!

The past is never dead.
